title: 第3章 希望种子
novel_title: 1960：九个妹妹把我宠上天(天下第九)
content_zh: “老辰回来了？”“嗯。”声音闷闷的，透着疲惫。“听说小楠掉河里了？没事吧？”“秀兰说醒了，我回来看看。”“那是得看看，这孩子体格弱，可别落下病根。”脚步声近了。停在门口。辰楠赶紧坐回床边，调整了一下呼吸。门被推开。一阵冷风卷着煤烟味灌进来。一个中年男人走了进来。个子挺高，背有点驼。穿着一身蓝色的工装，上面沾满了油污和铁屑。袖口磨破了，露出里面的棉絮。脸上满是皱纹，两鬓斑白，看着像五十多，其实才四十出头。这就是他爸，辰东南。一个沉默寡言，却像老黄牛一样扛起这个家的男人。辰东南进屋，先把门关严实了。然后才转过身，目光落在辰楠身上。那眼神很复杂。有担忧，有心疼，还有一丝深深的无奈。他没说话，只是大步走过来，伸出一只粗糙的大手。那手上全是老茧，指甲缝里嵌着洗不掉的黑油。手背在辰楠额头上贴了一下。粗粝，温热。“不烧。”辰东南收回手，声音沙哑。“爸。”辰楠喊了一声。这一声喊得自然，没有半点隔阂。“嗯。”辰东南应了一声，在床边的板凳上坐下。板凳发出“嘎吱”一声抗议。他从怀里掏出一个纸包。油纸的，皱皱巴巴。小心翼翼地打开，里面是两个白面馒头。还冒着点热气。那是厂里食堂的细粮，一个月也没几顿。他没舍得吃，揣怀里带回来了。“吃吧。”辰东南把馒头递过来。“刚才听你妈说了，没事就好。”“以后离河边远点。”“常伟那小子……以后少搭理。”提到常伟，辰东南的眼里闪过一丝怒气，但很快又被压了下去。他是老实人，斗不过人家。常伟他爸可是有头有脸的人物。辰楠看着那两个馒头。白白的，软软的。在这个年代，这就是顶级美食。这就是父爱。沉甸甸的，不善言辞，但实在。辰楠接过馒头，掰了一半。“爸，你也吃。”辰东南摆手，从兜里掏出烟袋锅子，想抽，看了看儿子，又塞了回去。“我不饿。我在厂里吃过了。”撒谎。肚子都在叫唤了。辰楠没拆穿他，把那一半馒头硬塞到他手里。“爸，我刚喝了红糖水，吃不下这么多。”“你陪我吃点，不然我也不吃。”辰东南看着手里的半个馒头，喉结滚动了一下。他是真饿。干了一天钳工活，那是重体力劳动，中午就喝了一碗稀粥。“吃吧。”辰楠咬了一口馒头。真香。麦子的甜味在嘴里化开。辰东南看着儿子，眼眶有点湿。孩子好像懂事了。掉了一次河，像是换了个人。他也咬了一口馒头，嚼得很慢，很仔细，舍不得咽下去。屋里很静。父子俩对着坐，啃着馒头。窗外的天色渐渐暗了下来。辰楠吃完最后一口，拍了拍手上的渣子。“爸，我想回趟乡下。”辰东南动作一顿，抬起头看着他。“回乡下干啥？你身体还没好利索。”“我想妹妹了。”辰楠看着辰东南的眼睛，一字一句地说。“我想去看看招娣她们。”“顺便，给家里弄点吃的。”辰东南苦笑了一下。“弄吃的？咱家哪还有多余的粮食……”“我有办法。”辰楠打断了他。眼神里透着一股前所未有的坚定。“爸，你信我。”“这次大难不死，我好像……开了窍了。”辰东南看着儿子。昏暗的光线里，儿子的眼睛亮得吓人。那种眼神，让他这个当爹的，竟然感到了一丝心安。“行。”辰东南沉默了半晌，点了点头。“等你养好身体再回去。”“我也想丫头们了。”他说着，低下头，狠狠地咬了一大口馒头。像是在咬碎生活的艰辛。辰楠转头看向窗外。夜幕降临，院子里亮起了昏黄的灯光。那是别人家的灯火。从今天起，他也要点亮属于辰家的灯火。用那个空间。用灵泉溪水。用这双重活一次的手。在这个贫瘠的年代，种出一个丰衣足食的未来。肚子里的灵泉溪水还在发热。力量在身体里涌动。辰楠嘴角微微勾起。六十年代，我来了。沉寂许久。辰东南又问，“那女娃不是在跟你处对象吗？她为什么不找人来救你？”“我们可没有处对象。”辰楠赶忙否认，就像是遇到了脏东西一般。以往是“他”一直舔着柳如意，这就让很多人都误会他们是一对。“不处对象你整天跟在人家屁股后面干什么？”辰东南觉得儿子被水淹了一下似乎开窍了，以往他都自诩是柳如意的对象，如今竟然否认了。“这……”这问题辰楠是真不知道如何回答好。总不能说那不是他吧？辰东南见儿子说不上话来，继续开口道：“还好你小子没事，以后可别犯浑了。”他一直不太喜欢柳如意，但自家媳妇对那女娃很喜欢，于是他也没有多说什么，哪知道如今就出了这样的事情。“老爸你放心吧，以前脑子让门夹，现在脑子进水，我已经清醒，以后再也不会这样。”辰东南诧异地看了辰楠一眼，这小子被水淹了一次还真开窍了？那女娃原本就对自家儿子比较冷淡，是自家儿子一直不知廉耻的跟着对方。他原本想着找机会敲打一下辰楠，但现在看来不需要了，这小子已经看清本质。“那女娃不适合你，以后少跟她来往。”辰东南摆摆手，这小子根本不需要他担心，他走到厨房捧起勺子水洗手。夕阳西下，晚霞漫天。晚霞把天边的云彩烧得通红，也把京城这个大杂院的屋顶染上了一层暖金色。放学的钟声仿佛还在空气里嗡嗡回响，院子里已经炸开了锅。孩子们追跑打闹的脚步声，母亲们吆喝孩子回家吃饭的声儿，还有不知道谁家收音机咿咿呀呀的唱戏声，混在一起，热闹得能把屋顶掀翻。唯独辰楠家里比较安静，毕竟家里没小孩，九个妹妹都在乡下呢。就在这时。厨房传来老妈的声音。“开饭！”李秀兰端着个大搪瓷盆从门外的小厨房进来，盆里是热气腾腾的棒子面粥，黄澄澄的，里面掺着煮得烂糊的南瓜块儿。一家三口围坐在那张旧方桌旁。粥很烫，辰楠吹着气，喝了一口。那粗糙的口感拉过嗓子眼，带着一股淡淡的南瓜甜味和玉米面的腥气。他咀嚼着嘴里的粥，心里却泛起一股难以言喻的别扭。这玩意儿，比起他在后世里啃过的压缩饼干还难吃。可他却看到爸妈吃得贼香，看来是他不适应了。没办法啊，如今到处缺粮食，正是艰难的三年。这个时代，太难了。辰楠勉强一口一口吃着，却看到爸妈吃得很香也很认真。“妈，”他低声说，“咱家还有南瓜籽不？”母亲愣了一下：“有倒是有，你要那干啥？”“有用，我……我想试试看能不能在外面没人发现的地方种点。”辰楠找了个借口。李秀兰也没多问，在围裙上擦了擦手，转身从柜子深处的一个小布包里，从里面翻出一小把种子直接递给他：“喏，都给你，省着点。”南瓜虽然好吃，但种子不算珍贵，主要是没那么多地种植，果实长得又不大。因此她也没太多存货，故而李秀兰随手就把存货都给了辰楠。辰楠接过种子，攥在手心掂量着，大概有十七八枚。这是粮食，这是希望的种子！夜幕降临。大杂院的喧嚣渐渐平息，只剩下几声遥远的狗吠和蛐蛐儿的鸣叫。辰楠回到房间躺下。过了好一会。确认爸妈都睡熟了。黑暗中，他的眼睛亮得惊人。心念一动，仿佛只是一个恍惚，他整个人就从狭窄的木板床上消失。下一刻，他已经置身于一个截然不同的世界。刚才房间里的黑暗与现在的光明透亮形成了鲜明的对比。这里空气清新得带着甜味，脚下是黝黑肥沃的土地，不远处一条清澈见底的小溪潺潺流淌，更远的地方弥漫着淡淡的混沌，看不真切里面有什么。空间里安静而空气清新。在这里，他就是至高无上的神。他摊开手掌，那十七八枚南瓜种子静静躺在掌心。不需要锄头，不需要水桶，甚至不需要弯腰。只是一个念头升起。他手中的南瓜籽便轻飘飘地悬浮起来，如同被无形的手托着，稳稳地飞向那片黑土地。黑土地自动翻开几个恰到好处的小坑，温柔地接住了种子，然后又轻轻覆上。溪流里，一道水流如同有了生命的银蛇，自主升起，划出一道优美的弧线，精准地洒落在刚刚播下种子的地方，水量不多不少，恰到好处地将土壤润湿。一切都在寂静中完成，行云流水，仿佛天地自然的法则本身就在按照他的意志运转。他就是这方天地的唯一真神。辰楠看着那几处微微湿润的土壤，满意地点点头。这里的黑土地很适合种植，上一世他就尝试过。辰楠并没有过多停留，他今晚还有更重要的事情要做。一个闪身，他如同进来时一样无声无息地离开了空间，重新回到了那张硬邦邦的木板床上。他深吸了一口气，悄无声息地坐起身，像个幽灵般离开大杂院，朝着城隍庙的位置赶去。今晚，他要出去一趟。
content_en: "Lao Chen is back?" "Yes." The voice was muffled, showing exhaustion."I heard that Xiao Nan fell into the river? Are you okay?" "Xiulan said she woke up, and I'll come back and have a look." "That's what I need to check. This child is weak, so don't let him get sick." The sound of footsteps was approaching.Stop at the door.Chen Nan quickly sat back on the bed and adjusted her breathing.The door was pushed open.A gust of cold wind blew in, carrying the smell of soot.A middle-aged man walked in.He is quite tall and has a slight hunchback.Wearing a blue overalls, stained with oil and iron filings.The cuffs were frayed, exposing the cotton wadding underneath.His face is full of wrinkles and his temples are gray. He looks like he is in his fifties, but is actually in his early forties.This is his dad, Chen Southeast.A taciturn man who carries the family like an old scalper.Chen Dongnan entered the house and closed the door tightly first.Then he turned around and his eyes fell on Chen Nan.That look was complicated.There is worry, distress, and a hint of deep helplessness.He didn't speak, just strode over and stretched out a big rough hand.The hands were covered with calluses, and there was black oil embedded in the nails that couldn't be washed off.The back of his hand touched Chen Nan's forehead.Coarse and warm."No burning." Chen Dongnan retracted his hand, his voice hoarse."Dad." Chen Nan shouted.This shout was natural and there was no barrier at all."Yeah." Chen Dongnan responded and sat down on the bench next to the bed.The bench creaked in protest.He took out a paper bag from his arms.Oily paper, wrinkled.Opening it carefully, there were two white steamed buns inside.Still a little steamy.That was fine food from the factory cafeteria, not many meals a month.He was reluctant to eat it and brought it back in his arms."Eat it." Chen Southeast handed the steamed bun over."I just heard what your mother said, just be fine." "Stay away from the river from now on." "That kid Chang Wei... don't talk to him anymore." When Chang Wei was mentioned, a trace of anger flashed in Chen Southeast's eyes, but it was quickly suppressed.He is an honest man and cannot beat others.Chang Wei's father is a prominent figure.Chen Nan looked at the two steamed buns.White and soft.In this day and age, this is top cuisine.This is fatherly love.Heavy, inarticulate, but true.Chen Nan took the steamed bun and broke it into half."Dad, you eat too." Chen Dongnan waved his hand, took out the pipe pot from his pocket, wanted to smoke, looked at his son, and stuffed it back."I'm not hungry. I ate at the factory." He lied.My stomach is growling.Chen Nan didn't expose him and forced the half of the steamed bun into his hand."Dad, I just drank brown sugar water and I can't eat so much." "You eat some with me, or I won't eat either." Chen Southeast looked at the half steamed bun in his hand, and his Adam's apple rolled.He is really hungry.After a day of hard work, I had a bowl of porridge at noon."Eat it." Chen Nan took a bite of the steamed bun.So delicious.The sweetness of wheat melts in your mouth.Chen Southeast looked at his son with tears in his eyes.The child seems to be sensible.After falling into a river, I felt like a different person.He also took a bite of the steamed bun, chewing it slowly and carefully, reluctant to swallow it.The room was quiet.Father and son sat opposite each other, eating steamed buns.The sky outside the window gradually darkened.Chen Nan finished the last bite and patted the residue on his hands."Dad, I want to go back to the countryside." Chen Southeast paused and raised his head to look at him."Why are you going back to the countryside? You're not feeling well yet." "I miss my sister." Chen Nan looked into Chen Southeast's eyes and said word by word."I want to go see Zhaodi and the others." "By the way, let's get some food for the family." Chen Southeast smiled bitterly."Get food? How can our family have any extra food..." "I have a way." Chen Nan interrupted him.There was an unprecedented determination in his eyes."Dad, you believe me." "I survived this catastrophe. I seem to have... enlightened myself." Chen Southeast looked at his son.In the dim light, the son's eyes were frighteningly bright.That kind of look made him, a father, feel a little at ease."Okay." Chen Southeast was silent for a while and nodded."Wait until you recover and go back." "I miss the girls too." He said, lowered his head and took a big bite of the steamed bun.Like chewing up the hardships of life.Chen Nan turned to look out the window.As night fell, dim lights lit up in the yard.That's the light from someone else's house.From today on, he will also light up the lights belonging to the Chen family.Use that space.Use Lingquan stream water.With these hands that live twice.In this barren era, plant a future with plenty of food and clothing.The spiritual spring water in my stomach is still heating up.Power surges through the body.The corners of Chen Nan's mouth raised slightly.In the 1960s, I came.There was silence for a long time.Chen Nannan asked again, "Isn't that girl having sex with you? Why doesn't she find someone to save you?" "We don't have sex with you." Chen Nan quickly denied it, as if he had encountered something dirty.In the past, "he" had been licking Liu Ruyi, which caused many people to misunderstand that they were a couple."Why are you following someone around all day if you don't have a partner?" Chen Dongnan felt that his son had become enlightened after being submerged in the water. In the past, he claimed to be Liu Ruyi's partner, but now he denied it."This..." Chen Nan really didn't know how to answer this question.You can't say it's not him, can you?Seeing that his son was speechless, Chen Southeast continued, "Fortunately, your kid is fine. Don't be stupid in the future." He had never liked Liu Ruyi, but his wife liked the girl very much, so he didn't say anything more. Who would have thought that something like this would happen now."Dad, don't worry. I used to have my brain stuck in the door, but now my brain is flooded. I'm awake now, and I'll never be like this again." Chen Nannan glanced at Chen Nan in surprise. Did this kid really wake up after being flooded once?The girl was originally rather cold towards her son, but it was her son who followed her shamelessly.He originally wanted to find an opportunity to hit Chen Nan, but now it seems that there is no need, this kid has seen the true nature of it."That girl is not suitable for you. Don't have any contact with her in the future." Chen Dongnan waved his hands. This boy didn't need to worry about him at all. He walked to the kitchen and picked up a spoon of water to wash his hands.The sun sets in the west and the sky is filled with sunset.The sunset burned the clouds in the sky red, and also dyed the roof of this large courtyard in the capital with a layer of warm gold.The school bell seemed to still be buzzing in the air, and the yard was already exploding.The sounds of children running and playing, the sounds of mothers shouting for their children to go home for dinner, and the sound of singing operas babbling from someone's radio, all mixed together to make the house so lively that it could tear down the roof.Only Chen Nan's family is relatively quiet. After all, there are no children at home and all nine sisters are in the countryside.Just then.Mom's voice came from the kitchen."Let's eat!" Li Xiulan came in from the small kitchen outside the door with a large enamel basin. In the basin was steaming hot stick noodle porridge, which was bright yellow and mixed with mashed pumpkin chunks.The family of three sat around the old square table.The porridge was very hot. Chen Nan blew on it and took a sip.The rough texture passed through the throat, with a faint sweetness of pumpkin and the fishy smell of cornmeal.He chewed the porridge in his mouth, but felt an indescribable awkwardness in his heart.This stuff was even worse than the compressed biscuits he had eaten in later generations.But he saw that his parents were eating very well, and it seemed that he was not used to it.There is no way. There is a shortage of food everywhere now. It has been a difficult three years.This era is so difficult.Chen Nan reluctantly ate one bite at a time, but saw that her parents were eating very well and seriously."Mom," he whispered, "do we still have pumpkin seeds at home?" The mother was stunned for a moment: "Yes, there are, what do you want them for?" "It's useful, I... I want to try to see if I can plant some in a place where no one will find it outside." Chen Nan made an excuse.Li Xiulan didn't ask any more questions, wiped her hands on her apron, turned around and took out a small handful of seeds from a small cloth bag deep in the cabinet and handed it to him directly: "Here, I'll give them all to you, save yourself." Although pumpkins are delicious, the seeds are not precious, mainly because there are not so many places to plant them, and the fruits are not big.Therefore, she didn't have much inventory, so Li Xiulan casually gave all the inventory to Chen Nan.Chen Nan took the seeds and weighed them in the palm of his hand. There were about seventeen or eight seeds.This is food, this is the seed of hope!Night falls.The hustle and bustle in the courtyard gradually subsided, leaving only a few distant barks of dogs and the chirping of crickets.Chen Nan returned to the room and lay down.After a while.Make sure both parents are asleep.In the darkness, his eyes were astonishingly bright.With a thought in his mind, as if it was just a trance, he disappeared from the narrow wooden bed.The next moment, he was in a completely different world.The darkness in the room just now was in stark contrast to the light and transparency now.The air here is fresh and sweet, with dark fertile land beneath your feet. A crystal clear stream gurgling not far away, and a faint chaos fills the area further away, making it difficult to tell what's inside.The space is quiet and the air is fresh.Here, he is the supreme God.He opened his palms, and the seventeen or eight pumpkin seeds lay quietly in his palms.No hoe required, no bucket required, or even bending down.Just a thought arises.The pumpkin seeds in his hand floated lightly, as if being held by invisible hands, flying steadily towards the black land.The black soil automatically opened a few small holes that were just right, gently caught the seeds, and then gently covered them again.In the stream, a stream of water is like a silver snake with life, rising on its own, drawing a beautiful arc, and accurately falling on the place where the seeds have just been sown. The amount of water is not too much and not too little, moistening the soil just right.Everything was done in silence, with flowing clouds and flowing water, as if the natural laws of heaven and earth were operating according to his will.He is the only true god in this world.Chen Nan looked at the slightly moist soil and nodded with satisfaction.The black soil here is very suitable for planting, and he tried it in his previous life.Chen Nan didn't stay too long, he had more important things to do tonight.With a flash, he left the space as silently as when he came in, and returned to the hard wooden bed.He took a deep breath, sat up quietly, and left the courtyard like a ghost, heading towards the City God's Temple.Tonight, he is going out.
